opening.argument: The presentation promotes StrongBlock node participation through a projected return exceeding $250,000 annually, dependent on a specified STRONG token price and the purchase of multiple nodes. The speaker describes the required commitment: “you need ten strong tokens in order to go ahead and actually create your own node” alongside a recurring maintenance fee, while forecasting that STRONG could rise “three to five x” in a strong season. Viewers are directed to connect a wallet, acquire the tokens, authorize the contract, and pay maintenance and gas fees; the video also presents a claim function for created nodes. Although it displays a calculator, app screens, a disclaimer, patience advice, and an audit page, those features do not establish that the projection—or any resulting financial outcome—is accurate.
